summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of its own Class XXX Notes (YMCWO) between April 22–29, 2026. The company bought back notes with a total par value of US$6,373,594 at an average price of 99.56% of nominal value, spending Ps.8,868,534,397.93. These notes were originally issued in July 2024 (US$185M) and April 2025 (US$204M) under Argentina's Frequent Issuer framework, maturing July 2026. The repurchased notes will be held in treasury. This open-market buyback reduces outstanding debt and is typical of liability management. Watch for potential cancellation or reissuance of the notes, which could affect bondholder recoveries.
